info.title: Afridict Backend API
info.description: Financial and prediction-market infrastructure API. Collateralized matching, governed resolution, redemption and Robinhood Chain settlement preparation operate only in the isolated synthetic testnet workflow. Real-money trading, mainnet settlement and production outcome finality remain disabled pending approved deployments, adapters and governance.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque Afridict session token. The server stores only its SHA-256 digest and checks revocation and expiry on every request.

413.description: VALIDATION_FAILED. Request body exceeds the configured size limit.

422.description: Invalid amount, asset, journal, market policy, template, source or policy reference. Correct semantic input before retrying.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED. Observe Retry-After and retry with the original command key.

Retry-After.description: Minimum delay in seconds before retrying.

500.description: INTERNAL_ERROR. Contact support with X-Request-Id; do not assume a command failed to commit.

502.description: A configured provider returned an invalid or mismatched response. Do not continue with the returned data.

503.description: Dependency, identity, financial integration or partner adapter unavailable. Retry only transient failures with the same command key.

Retry-After.description: Minimum delay in seconds before retrying.
